release_notes:
FocusDefend v3.8.0 (Build 73): CodeRabbit Review Hardening & Dual Security Sign-Off.
• Query Sanitization: UUID regex gating on profile link queries preventing Postgres 22P02 syntax errors.
• Live Native Sync: Realtime Supabase restriction changes stream directly into the Android native engine.
• Sensory Centralization: Challenge vibration encapsulated in shared global haptic preferences.
• Touch Accessibility: Back button hitSlop expanded to exceed 44x44dp Material 3 standards.
